# Included dgVoodoo archive

`dgVoodoo2_87_5.zip` is the original, unmodified upstream release by Dege.
See the repository's [third-party notices](../../THIRD_PARTY.md) for the source,
checksums, attribution, and redistribution terms.

The installer extracts only the x86 D3D8 wrapper and the default configuration
template needed by Railroad Tycoon 3. The archive is retained intact so it also
includes the author's control panel and documentation links.
